title: Leadership and Church Administration
description: Servant leadership and the practical administration of a local church. Students study biblical models of leadership (Moses, David, Nehemiah, Jesus, Paul), the qualifications and character of elders and deacons, church governance and polity, vision and planning, team building, conflict resolution, stewardship and finances, legal and ethical responsibilities, worship planning, volunteer development, and leading through change - drawing on Gregory the Great, Ambrose, Chrysostom, Calvin and the church orders of the early church.

lessons.paper_prompt: Write a 1,500-2,000 word leadership case study and plan. Describe a realistic church situation (for example conflict among leaders, a needed change, a financial crisis, or leadership transition), apply biblical models of servant leadership, draw on at least two library sources (such as Gregory the Great, Ambrose, Chrysostom or Calvin; cite as Author, Title, section), and present a concrete action plan with safeguards and ways to measure faithfulness.
